body: #2597: ADVISOR RULING on the PR. Do not merge as-is. The 18-min stress step on every Build and the 25->45 timeout bump are blockers. FIX-FORWARD (you take it): move the stress to a nightly/dispatch workflow (or a path-filtered one), restore timeout 25, and update ci-gate-tiers.toml and the docs. Then a fresh standard review of the wiring delta only.
subject: #2597 ruling: stress step off per-PR Build before merge
